title: Restore active avatar focus, notification failure recovery and settings help drift; retire replaced wrappers

source.ref: Current-main residual consumer review confirmed three active gaps hidden by old wrapper tests

detail: The active ProfilePhoto now receives the already-loaded profile metadata focal point and demo flag, strips avatar URL focal fragments and preserves their fallback when no metadata choice exists. Kit geometry and initials remain unchanged; no new profile read. Actual Frequency BellButton/BellSheet are extracted without moving the mounted header doors: unavailable counts remain announced, failed list reads never mark unseen notices, transport/write failures expose generic retry feedback, and unread clears only after successful persistence and mounted buttons track refreshed server counts through the existing store. The existing RLS mark-all-read action now propagates update errors instead of revalidating false success. The initial load runs after effect commit; duplicate/unmounted work is refused. Help drift now maps actual Frequency settings source files to location/resonance articles, with exact-prefix boundaries and real-path checks. Six duplicate internal wrappers are retired only after active rendered/action/source consequences replace their tests: old ConnectionsSection, NotificationBell, UpgradeCrew, ProfileAvatar, HoverTip and UnclaimedBadge. Shared Avatar/Badge, real ticker keyboard/motion behavior, canonical upgrade route/launcher/gates, actual Unclaimed classified tags and all settings controls remain. Canonical SCAN621/686 probes now inspect the mounted bell while retaining discriminated feed/count loader and narrow-revalidation checks. Extracted bell lines remain included under the unchanged 1800-line core chrome ceiling. No production interaction, new privilege, schema or provider operation.

verify.evidence: 181 focused tests across11files pass, plus15 bell/count-refresh and retained ticker rendered-motion checks. Focused rendered/action/source regression suites and existing primitive/help/upgrade/ticker tests pass. Planted active-bell early-read and dropped-error-return mutations fail; retired-module reimports fail for each of six actual-root samples; actual classified body/grid renders Unclaimed only for true input. Actual metadata focus/demo forwarding, URL fallback and initials pass. New source-prefix mappings reject unrelated/lookalike edits and require real files. Focused lint, direct active-bell/retirement probes, unchanged shell-size guard and whitespace checks pass. Evidence is source/mocked rendered/action only, not authenticated browser or deployment acceptance. Independent broad typing/build/CI belongs to the final integration head.
